info.name: Kapomatic Warehouse API
info.description: Collection for Warehouse backend APIs (categories, customers, products, credit-sales, sellings, cart checkout, website currency, and shipping settings), updated to match current request fields and filters. Customer details now return lastCreditSaleDate, lastCashSaleDate, lastCreditSalePaymentDate, and creditSummary with debtStatusSummary, totalDebtAmount, paidAmount, remainingAmount, totalRefundDueAmount, totalReturnedPaidAmount, and totalReallocatedPaidAmount. Customer deletion now blocks outstanding credit invoices, returns a confirmation response for fully paid related credit invoices, and supports restoreCreditInvoices/restoreCreditSales/restoreInvoices to delete with or without restoring invoice items to inventory. Products now support purchasePrice and profit report endpoints. Cash and credit refunds are created only through POST /api/returns using returnType and invoiceId. Cash full refunds delete the selling invoice; cash partial refunds hide refunded item quantities from selling invoice responses. Invoice DELETE endpoints remove only the invoice row and do not change inventory. Credit-sale requests support customer linking, payment registration, partial or full invoice refunds, refundDueAmount tracking, automatic returnedPaidAmount handling on full refunds, automatic reallocatedPaidAmount handling when a partial refund creates overpayment, invoice status changing to Reactionary on full return, inventory deduction/restoration, and optional discountAmount plus shippingFees invoice fields. Selling creation returns HTTP 409 with shortage details when inventory is insufficient and supports confirmInsufficientInventory to auto-restock the missing quantity and complete the full sale. Cart checkout creates pending website orders from customer, shipping location, and products payloads. Confirming a website order creates the linked selling invoice; website orders can be listed by pending, accepted, and refunded status. Website settings store the currency, government shipping fees, and the minimum amount for free shipping. Update Product applies newInventory only when the payload inventoryCount matches the product's current stored inventoryCount. Selling and credit-sale responses now expose profit-related item fields. SEO and multilingual support requests are included for localized category/product slugs, slug availability, public localized lookups, slug aliases, crawlable public image URLs, localized search, and sitemap feeds.

item.name: Get Categories With Products And Settings

request.description: Returns each category with products, setting, and category.filters built from category specifications. Each filter includes values containing the unique product specification values for that category. The same computed filters are also exposed as category.specifications for compatibility.

Returns only an array of category specification filters. Each object has title, isVisible, and values. values are unique specification values from all products in this category, and isVisible reflects the saved e-commerce setting filter visibility when available.

Response includes success, products, and pagination only. Add page and limit for pagination, sort/filter with price_asc, price_desc, or rating_desc, and one or more specification/value query pairs to search displayed products by matching product specification values.

request.description: Returns customer details plus lastCreditSaleDate, lastCashSaleDate, lastCreditSalePaymentDate, creditSummary, and creditHistory. creditSummary includes debtStatusSummary, totalDebtAmount, paidAmount, remainingAmount, totalRefundDueAmount, totalReturnedPaidAmount, and totalReallocatedPaidAmount.

Adds a payment to the customer's first open invoice or last open invoice. Send exactly one of firstInvoice or lastInvoice as true. If lastInvoice is selected and amount exceeds that invoice remainingAmount, the backend distributes the extra amount to the customer's other open invoices in newest-to-oldest order. If amount exceeds the customer's totalRemainingAmount across open invoices, the API returns message, invoiceId, remainingAmount, and totalRemainingAmount.

Deletes a customer when there are no related credit invoices. If the customer has outstanding credit invoices, the API returns 400 with outstandingInvoiceCount, outstandingAmount, and outstandingInvoices. If all related credit invoices are fully paid and no restore flag is supplied, the API returns 409 with requiresConfirmation and confirmationField=restoreCreditInvoices.

Confirms customer deletion and deletes related fully paid credit invoices without restoring invoice items to product inventory. The backend also accepts restoreCreditSales or restoreInvoices as aliases for restoreCreditInvoices.

Confirms customer deletion, deletes related fully paid credit invoices, restores invoice quantities to product inventoryCount, and reduces soldItemCount. The response includes creditInvoicesRestored, deletedCreditInvoiceCount, restoredProductCount, and restoredItemCount.

request.description: Copies the product's current purchasePrice into matching cash and credit invoice items, then recalculates stored item profit. dateFrom and dateTo are optional; if omitted, all invoices for the product are updated.

Updates product details including discountPercentage (0-100). The response includes priceAfterDiscount. Set editProduct to true when editing product details without applying newInventory. If both inventoryCount and newInventory are sent, newInventory is added only when editProduct is not true and inventoryCount matches the product's current stored inventoryCount. If they differ, newInventory is ignored.

request.description: Creates a credit return through the centralized returns endpoint. For a full invoice return, replace items with { "refundAll": true }. When a partial refund creates overpayment, the backend reallocates it to the customer's other open credit invoices first, then returns any leftover cash in returnedPaidAmount and stores the transferred amount in reallocatedPaidAmount. When the invoice is fully returned, the backend returns the invoice paidAmount, stores it in returnedPaidAmount, and changes status to Reactionary.

exec: pm.test("Checkout creates a pending website order", function () {

request.description: Creates a pending website order from the storefront checkout form. Required fields: customerName, customerPhone, government, shippingLocation, paymentMethod, and products. paymentMethod accepts cash, wallet, or instapay. Wallet and InstaPay require transferPhone and transferImage. transferImage must be a base64 image string or data URI. The government must exist in Government Shipping Fees; the backend calculates shippingFees and applies the configured free-shipping threshold. Each product requires productId and price; quantity is optional and defaults to 1. Confirm the website order to create a selling invoice.
